card.name: Words before diagnostic test mentions
card.fires_on: Words that sit just before the noun "tests" or "test", mainly in phrases such as "FDA-authorized tests", "FDA-approved test" and "regulating complex genetic and other tests". It also fires weakly on a few other linking words in clinical text.

modes.label: FDA-approved test phrases
modes.description: The word "authorized" or "-approved" right after FDA, ahead of "test" in patient-selection notes.
modes.example: Information on FDA-<<authorized>> tests for the detection of dMMR

modes.label: Regulation of lab tests
modes.description: Words in a sentence about guidance for regulating genetic and other laboratory tests.
modes.example: the agency developed guidance for<< regulating>> complex genetic and other tests sold by laboratories

modes.label: Scattered other positions
modes.description: Linking words in other clinical phrases, such as "on" before chest x-ray.
modes.example: a reticulonodular pattern<< on>> chest x-ray was observed in a small

card.plain: It lights up on the words leading into a mention of a diagnostic test, especially FDA-approved tests used to pick patients.
